messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: spike in 5xx and timeout errors on private-vpc-inference-gw-us-east-1 detected by alerting rule gw.5xx_rate > 2% for 5m. Paging @sre-oncall and @netops-bot.

alicia: ack — I'm looking. seeing error rate jump ~03:12 UTC. dashboards show increase in 502/504 and some TCP RSTs.

ben: any recent peering or firewall changes from config-rollout?

dinesh: ops console shows a peering route update at 02:58 UTC from infra-team, but it was marked low-risk. pinging infra for details.

alicia: quick check of NAT metrics: ephemeral port utilization at 95% on the private NAT cluster in us-east-1a. conntrack entries high ~380k (threshold 300k).

netops-bot: automated note — NAT instance nat-priv-03 restarted 02:59 UTC due to kernel oom; restarted by autoscaler.

ben: that would explain ephemeral exhaustion leading to 5xx proxies. are the gw nodes retrying and hitting closed ports -> 504s?

alicia: yes. logs from inference-gw show lots of "upstream reset" and "connect timeout". snippet: ```
[03:12:34] warn: upstream connect timeout to 10.0.45.23:443
[03:12:35] error: 502 Bad Gateway from upstream
```

eva: any security group changes that could drop return traffic? I don't see recent SG updates in the audit log.

alicia: SGs look unchanged. seems resource exhaustion on NAT + flapping peering route produced asymmetric return path.

dinesh: confirmed — infra change rolled a route for peering-nyc->use1 to prefer a transit appliance; parity test shows asymmetric path for some flows. rolling back that route now.

sre-oncall: mitigation checklist — 1) throttle non-critical egress (disable background backups) 2) add temporary SNAT pool on gw-nat-standby 3) increase conntrack max via sysctl on nat-priv nodes 4) rollback peering route change if rollouts coincide.

alicia: doing 1) now -> disabling nightly backup jobs in kube-system via patch: ```kubectl -n kube-system patch cronjob backup-job -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'```

ben: 2) provisioning extra SNAT on gw-nat-standby (manual) — assigning 8 new ephemeral ports range. ETA ~2m.

netops-bot: provisioning request accepted — nat-standby allocated additional SNAT pool: 172.31.200.0/28 attached to nat-standby-02.

alicia: 3) bumping conntrack: ```sudo sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=600000``` applied on nat-priv-01/02/03. monitoring.

alicia: immediate effect: ephemeral usage dropped to 70% on nat-priv cluster, 5xx rate starting to decline.

customer-ops: Customer impact: two enterprise customers (acme-corp and fin-lytics) reported elevated latency and 502s across inference endpoints from 03:10-03:28 UTC. Estimated 12% of requests failed during peak. SOCs notified.

dinesh: peering rollback complete at 03:18 UTC. route table now matches pre-rollout.

ben: I'm seeing gateway errors drop to baseline 0.4% now. continuing to observe for 30m.

sre-oncall: Please keep the incident channel updated. I'll prepare a short incident note and start an RCA doc. Assigning follow-ups:
- alicia: build a playbook entry for ephemeral port exhaustion and automated SNAT scaling
- dinesh: audit peering rollout process, add pre-checks for NAT utilization
- ben: evaluate autoscaler thresholds for NAT restart bounce behavior
- eva: coordinate customer comms and send a status update to impacted accounts

alicia: opening a runbook PR now and adding the sysctl change as a temporary safeguard.

dinesh: filing a rollback postmortem and flagging the route change with infra release owner.

customer-ops: Sent initial impact note to acme-corp & fin-lytics, offering incident summary and timeline.

sre-oncall: escalations closed for now — error rates under SLO. Keeping monitoring alerts in watch mode for 1h. Handoff to night oncall @sre-night for 04:00 UTC.

alicia: leaving a pinned diagnostic: ```netstat -s | grep -i conntrack``` and kube proxy logs filtered for RSTs.

ben: post-incident actions: consider implementing ephemeral port pooling and safer NAT autoscale cooldowns.

incident-bot: Incident resolved -> severity: high -> summary: "NAT ephemeral port exhaustion + peering route change caused transient 5xx/timeouts for private inference gateway; mitigated via SNAT pool addition, conntrack increase, and peering rollback." Timeline: 03:10 UTC alert -> 03:18 UTC peering rollback -> 03:28 UTC error rates back to baseline.

sre-oncall: assigning tickets and closing channel after RCA draft is posted. Thanks all for fast response. :clap:
